jurisdiction.name: Guinea-Bissau
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Guinea-Bissau has published no AI-specific law, strategy, guidance or regulator document. Its only relevant national policy is the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030, approved by Decree 10/2025, which has no official text online, and the country has no data protection law or authority.
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. Parliament and the ICT regulator's websites were searched in full and no AI documents were found; the digital transformation strategy and a draft data protection law are listed as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: The National People's Assembly's legislation and treaty pages, the telecommunications and information technology regulator's full site, the government and ministries were searched at national level. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The Official Bulletin and the government portal have no working online site, so the text of the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 (Decree 10/2025) and the status of a reported data protection bill remain leads to check later.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. anp.gw (legislation and treaties pages, all posts) and arn.gw (all posts and PDFs via its API) scanned: no AI documents. Boletim Oficial has no working online portal; gov.gw does not resolve; itma.gw 404. Central banking is regional (BCEAO). Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found. No AI law, no AI provisions, no data protection law and no AI bill. The Boletim Oficial has no reachable online portal (boletimoficial.gw does not resolve). Legislation and treaty pages of the Assembleia Nacional Popular (anp.gw) and all ARN-TIC legislation pages were checked. Only telecom/ICT law is published (Lei n.º 5/2010 and its regulations), and none of it mentions AI. The ARN consultation on a draft Electronic Transactions Law (29/04/2026) is not AI-specific.; Government: Searched, nothing found on AI. No national AI strategy. The National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 (Decree 10/2025) has no official online text, so it is held as a lead and its AI content was not checked. gov.gw does not resolve and itma.gw returns 404.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found. No AI documents from the education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries, or from the Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, turned up in search. None of these ministries has a working document website.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found. The ARN-TIC telecom/ICT regulator was scanned in full (all posts and all PDF media). It has no AI guidance; its only AI mention is a 2024 news item on attending a forum. There is no data protection authority or national cyber agency. Central banking and financial supervision are regional (BCEAO/UEMOA), so they are outside this national pass.. Not reached: Boletim Oficial (no working official online portal); Government portal gov.gw (does not resolve); ITMA (itma.gw returns 404). Could not verify: Decree 10/2025 / ENTD.GW full text and AI content (no official online copy; gazette and gov.gw unreachable); Status of the reported data protection bill. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

leads.title: Decreto n.º 10/2025 — aprova a Estratégia Nacional para a Transformação Digital da Guiné-Bissau 2025-2030 (ENTD.GW)
leads.english_title: Decree No. 10/2025 approving the National Digital Transformation Strategy of Guinea-Bissau 2025-2030 (ENTD.GW)
leads.issuing_authority: Government of Guinea-Bissau (Council of Ministers); Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and Digital Economy
leads.note: Reported as published in the Boletim Oficial No. 12, 4th supplement, 28 March 2025 (six strategic objectives, 55 interventions). No official full text found online: the gazette has no working web portal, and the ARN-TIC site (arn.gw) carries only a 29/11/2024 workshop page on the draft. Whether it contains an AI pillar or AI interventions could not be checked. Promote to a 'strategy' record only if an official text is found and it covers AI.

leads.title: Projeto de lei de proteção de dados pessoais
leads.note: Secondary sources say drafting of a data protection law has begun. No official draft, bill, or ARN/parliament consultation found. Guinea-Bissau has no national data protection law or authority.
